prose.description: A person's own words, never read to decide anything. It holds something other than spaces.

proseList.description: Several of a person's own words, each holding something other than spaces.

name.description: An identifier: a ticket, a lane, a check, a lease, a finding or a finish line.

path.description: A repository path or path pattern.

base.description: A base by its branch and the head it stood at, both present.

changeRequest.description: A change request, by the name the record holds for it: the forge's address or its own key.

reason.description: A stop's code: one of the queue's stop reasons, merge-queue-result/1's reason.

log.description: A check's log, relative to the state directory.

stage.description: The stage a piece stood at.

baseSource.description: What found or settled the main line's health: the queue, a full run, or the lead.

supersededPhase.description: Which part of a failed candidate's run a superseding entry ended: the rest of its own checks, or its re-run on the main line.

rerunVerdict.description: What a re-run on the main line found: the main line is broken, the failure is the piece's, or no verdict was reached.

suiteEvidence.description: The suite evidence a hand-off carries: each check run at a head and tree, with its result.

addedChecks.description: Checks added to a selection, each with why.

span.description: Lines first to after, as [first, after).

carry.description: A review carried across base commits: the head it covered, the head it now covers, the captured review's digest, and the base commits between.

snapshotCause.description: Why a snapshot could not be taken, by the state tool's fixed classes of reason.

record.started.label: Started
record.started.explain: The lead opened the record. Everything after it happened in this delivery.
record.started.instruction: On the epic: the delivery started, naming its base and the head it started from.

story.added.label: Piece added
story.added.explain: The lead added a piece to the plan while the delivery ran.
story.added.instruction: On the epic: the piece the lead added to the plan, its title, and why.

lane.assigned.label: Picked up
lane.assigned.explain: The lead gave a piece to a lane, which starts work on it.
lane.assigned.instruction: On the ticket: it moves to started, naming the lane and what it delivers.

review.round.label: Review round

words.head: Review round {round} on {subject}
words.line: Findings: {findings.P0} P0, {findings.P1} P1, {findings.P2} P2 and {findings.P3} P3[, after {refused:count:refused result}][, restarted {restarts:count:time}]

review.round.explain: The reviewers read the piece once and each gave a verdict. A piece goes on only when every reviewer approves.
review.round.instruction: None: a lane posts each round on its own ticket, as its brief says, and the lead posts the integration review's rounds on the epic.

review.started.label: Review round started

words.line: At {head:commit}, read by {lenses:list}[, {moved:count:commit} since the last round][. {why}]

review.started.explain: A review round began: the reviewers are reading the piece at one commit.
review.started.instruction: None: a lane posts each round on its own ticket once it is reduced, and the round in flight shows in the record and the views.

review.lens.returned.label: Reviewer back

head.otherwise: {lens} asked for changes on round {round} of {subject}

words.line: Findings: {findings.P0} P0, {findings.P1} P1, {findings.P2} P2 and {findings.P3} P3

review.lens.returned.explain: One reviewer finished reading the round and gave its verdict.
review.lens.returned.instruction: None: the verdict posts with the round's own update, and the reviewer's return shows in the record and the views.

review.recorded.label: Review kept
review.recorded.explain: The tool kept the review's own record, so the views can show it later.
review.recorded.instruction: None: the lane already posted each captured round on its own ticket; the evidence shows in the record and the views.

review.carried.label: Review carried

words.head: The review of {subject} was carried
words.line: From {from:commit} to {to:commit}[, across {baseCommits:list:commit} from the main line]. {why}

review.carried.explain: The lead judged that a review still covers the piece after a commit that needed no new round.
review.carried.instruction: On the ticket: the lead carried the review from the head it covered to the queued head, and why it still covers the piece.

candidate.handed.label: Handed off

cases.true: No change needed[, with {checks:list} run by the lane]

line.otherwise: Ready[ after {rounds:count:review round}][, with {checks:list} run by the lane][, its review carried from {carry.from:commit}]

candidate.handed.explain: A lane says its piece is ready. The lead checks the claim before anything is run on it.
candidate.handed.instruction: On the ticket: the hand-off checked as a claim and queued, with its change request, reviewed head and review rounds.

handoff.checked.label: Hand-off checked

words.head: The lead checked the hand-off of {subject}

handoff.checked.explain: The lead read the lane's claim against the record before accepting it.
handoff.checked.instruction: None: the acceptance posts with `handoff.accepted`, and the lead's notes show in the record and the views.

handoff.accepted.label: Accepted
handoff.accepted.explain: The lead accepted the hand-off, so the queue can take the piece.
handoff.accepted.instruction: On the ticket: the lead accepted the hand-off, and the queue takes the piece, or it settled with no change.

handoff.rejected.label: Sent back
handoff.rejected.explain: The lead found the hand-off wrong and returned the piece to its lane.
handoff.rejected.instruction: On the ticket: the lead sent the hand-off back to its lane, and why.

handoff.requeued.label: Back in the queue
handoff.requeued.explain: The lead put a stopped piece back in the queue to be checked again.
handoff.requeued.instruction: On the ticket: the lead put the stopped piece back in the queue, at its head.

check.selected.label: Checks chosen

words.head: The lead chose the checks for {subject}

check.selected.explain: The lead chose which checks a piece runs, from what it changes.
check.selected.instruction: None: the lead's selection and its reason show in the record and the views, and the checks it ran post with `candidate.merged` or `candidate.stopped`.

check.selection.cleared.label: Choice cleared

words.head: The lead cleared the checks chosen for {subject}

check.selection.cleared.explain: The lead stopped choosing a piece's checks, so the usual ones run.
check.selection.cleared.instruction: None: the provider selects the candidate's checks again, and the checks it ran post with `candidate.merged` or `candidate.stopped`.

selection.refused.label: Checks refused

words.head: The checks for {subject} could not be chosen

selection.refused.explain: The tool that picks a piece's checks refused, so the piece waits for the lead.
selection.refused.instruction: None: the stop posts with `candidate.stopped`, and the provider's words show in the record and the views.

check.started.label: Checking
check.started.explain: The queue began running a piece's checks.
check.started.instruction: None: checking is transient, and its outcome posts with `candidate.merged` or `candidate.stopped`.

check.finished.label: Checked
check.finished.explain: The queue finished running a piece's checks.
check.finished.instruction: None: its outcome posts with `candidate.merged` or `candidate.stopped`.

check.failed.label: Check failed
check.failed.explain: A check failed on a piece. What happens next depends on whether the main line fails it too.
check.failed.instruction: None: its outcome posts with `candidate.stopped` once the failure is classified.

check.superseded.label: Run ended early

cases.base-rerun: The run on the main line was ended early

head.otherwise: The rest of the checks were ended early

check.superseded.explain: A check had already failed, so the piece wasn't going to merge; a new hand-off or a broken main line ended the rest of its run.
check.superseded.instruction: None: the acceptance or the broken main line that ended the run posts on its own.

check.retried.label: Check retried

cases.true: {check} ran again on the main line

check.retried.explain: A check that failed in a known flaky way was given one more try.
check.retried.instruction: On the flake's tracking reference: one more retry, naming the candidate and the failing tests, as evidence for fixing the flake.

check.reused.label: Check reused

words.head: {check} was not run again
words.line: Its run for {from} at {head:commit} was used

check.reused.explain: A check's earlier run on the same code was used instead of running it again.
check.reused.instruction: None: the candidate's work item already says it was handed off and is being checked; the reused check shows in the record and the views.

check.carried.label: Checks carried

words.head: Checks carried to the new main line

check.carried.explain: The main line moved in ways a check never reads, so its run carried over instead of running again.
check.carried.instruction: None: the candidate's work item already says it was handed off and is being checked; the carried checks and the base commits they were not run on show in the record and the views.

candidate.merged.label: Landed

cases.true: {subject} landed before the lead accepted it

words.line: At {head:commit}[, found later on the forge at {recovery.head:commit}]

candidate.merged.explain: A piece reached the main line.
candidate.merged.instruction: On the ticket: the merge commit, the checks run, and any check reported but not awaited; the ticket moves to its review or completed state.

candidate.stopped.label: Stopped
candidate.stopped.explain: The queue stopped a piece before it landed. It stays stopped until a new hand-off or the lead answers it.
candidate.stopped.instruction: On the ticket: the stop code and what happens next, whether returned to the lane, re-queued or pending a decision.

base.rerun.started.label: Trying the main line
base.rerun.started.explain: A check failed on a piece, so it runs on the main line too, to see whose failure it is.
base.rerun.started.instruction: None: the candidate's failure already reached the lead as `check.failed`, and the record and the views show the re-run in progress.

base.rerun.finished.label: Main line tried

cases.base_broken: The main line failed it too

head.otherwise: The main line gave no verdict

base.rerun.finished.explain: The run on the main line ended, and said whether the failure was the piece's or the main line's.
base.rerun.finished.instruction: None: its verdict posts with `candidate.stopped`, or with `base.broken` when the base fails the check too.

base.rerun.stopped.label: Try stopped

words.head: The run on the main line stopped

base.rerun.stopped.explain: The run on the main line ended without a verdict, so the piece is checked once more.
base.rerun.stopped.instruction: None: a stopped re-run has no verdict, the candidate is queued again and checked once more, and a second stop at the same heads posts with `candidate.stopped`.

base.broken.label: Main line broke

cases.fullHealth: The full run failed[ at {head:commit}][, after {after} landed][: {detail}]
cases.lead: The lead named it broken[ at {head:commit}][: {test} in {check}][. {why}]

base.broken.explain: A check failed on the main line itself, not only on a piece. Nothing lands until it is repaired.

tracker.heading: The delivery base is broken; the queue is stopped

base.broken.instruction: On the epic: the stop code and its detail (the failing check, an unverified merge, a base that moved under a batch, or a batch that landed in part), and that the queue is stopped; `base.repaired` reopens it.

base.repaired.label: Main line repaired
base.repaired.explain: The main line passes again, so pieces can land once more.
base.repaired.instruction: On the epic: the fix that landed and the gap it closed.

base.verified.label: Main line passed

words.head: The main line passed its full run

base.verified.explain: The full run on the main line passed after a piece landed.
base.verified.instruction: None: the post-merge `fullHealth` passed at the base head the named merge reached, and the result shows in the record and the views.

base.flaky.label: Main line flaky

words.head: The main line's full run was flaky
words.line: {failing:list} failed and then passed[, after {after} landed]

base.flaky.explain: The full run failed, but its failures passed when run alone, so the main line is not broken.
base.flaky.instruction: None: the post-merge `fullHealth` failed and its failing tests passed when re-run alone, so the base isn't broken; the flaky tests show in the record, the views and "Needs you".

base.moved.label: Main line moved
base.moved.explain: The lead brought new work from the default branch into the main line.
base.moved.instruction: On the epic, record the previous and published base heads and the default branch commit.

base.published.label: Main line pushed
base.published.explain: The lead pushed the main line to the shared remote.
base.published.instruction: None: the push shows in the record and the views; a base move posts with `base.moved`.

base.merge.authorized.label: Merge allowed

cases.lane: {lane:lane} chose to merge the main line into {subject}

head.otherwise: The lead let {lane:lane} merge the main line into {subject}

base.merge.authorized.explain: Exact commits from the main line were allowed into a piece: by the lead, or by its lane before it handed the piece off.
base.merge.authorized.instruction: None: the lane runs the merge the lead authorized, and its hand-off posts with `candidate.handed`.

ownership.granted.label: Files given
ownership.granted.explain: The lead changed which lane may edit a file.
ownership.granted.instruction: None: which lane may edit a file shows in the record and the views.

ownership.revoked.label: Files taken back
ownership.revoked.explain: The lead changed which lane may edit a file.
ownership.revoked.instruction: None: which lane may edit a file shows in the record and the views.

ownership.claimed.label: Files claimed
ownership.claimed.explain: A delivery claimed a path on a shared base, so a peer delivery's lead is warned before changing it.
ownership.claimed.instruction: None: the delivery's claim on a path of the shared base shows in the record and the views, and a peer delivery's lead is warned of it.

plan.updated.label: Plan rebuilt
plan.updated.explain: The plan's page was rebuilt from the plan file.
plan.updated.instruction: None: the plan chapter shows the rebuilt plan.

cleanup.done.label: Cleaned up
cleanup.done.explain: The lead removed a landed piece's branch and checkout.
cleanup.done.instruction: None: a landed piece's branch and checkout are gone, and its merge already posted with `candidate.merged`.

followup.filed.label: Follow-up filed
followup.filed.explain: A note left open by a review became its own ticket.
followup.filed.instruction: None: the follow-up is its own ticket, and the decision that deferred its note posted with `decision.recorded`.

work.cleared.label: Cleared from the record
work.cleared.explain: The tracker sweep removed work it had added itself, because that work belongs to another delivery.
work.cleared.instruction: None: the work belongs to another delivery, and its ticket is that delivery's to update.

snapshot.stale.label: Snapshot stale

words.head: The {source} snapshot went out of date

snapshot.stale.explain: The tracker or forge could not be read again, so the last reading stands.
snapshot.stale.instruction: None: the last snapshot stands, and the views say how old it is.

snapshot.retaken.label: Snapshot current
snapshot.retaken.explain: The tracker or forge was read again after a gap.
snapshot.retaken.instruction: None: the views read the fresh snapshot.

sibling.added.label: Sibling named

words.head: The lead named {sibling} as a sibling delivery
words.line: Its stories are read from its hosted view

sibling.added.explain: The lead named another repository's delivery of the same epic, by its hosted link.
sibling.added.instruction: None: the views show the sibling's stories once it is read.

sibling.removed.label: Sibling removed

words.head: The lead removed {sibling} as a sibling delivery

sibling.removed.explain: The lead stopped reading another repository's delivery.
sibling.removed.instruction: None: the views stop showing the sibling.

sibling.mismatched.label: Sibling of another epic
sibling.mismatched.explain: A sibling's published snapshot names another tracker parent, so its stories are not part of this epic.
sibling.mismatched.instruction: None: the lead removes the sibling or fixes its link.

sibling.landed.label: Sibling story landed

words.head: {subject} landed in {sibling}
words.line: First seen landed when {sibling} was read

sibling.landed.explain: A fresh read of a sibling delivery first showed one of its stories landed. The time is when it was seen, not when it merged.
sibling.landed.instruction: None: the views draw the sibling's story as landed.

evidence.published.label: Evidence published
evidence.published.explain: The lead published recordings that show the work running.
evidence.published.instruction: On the epic: where the recordings of the work running are, and what each shows.

flake.declared.label: Flake declared
flake.declared.explain: The lead recorded a check as flaky, so its known failure is tried again once.
flake.declared.instruction: On the epic: the check declared flaky, its known failure, the reference that tracks it, and the base head it applies to.

fullhealth.skipped.label: Full run skipped
fullhealth.skipped.explain: The main line's full run did not run, under the delivery's posture.
fullhealth.skipped.instruction: On the epic: the full run was skipped at the base head, under the delivery's posture, and why.

fullhealth.rerun.label: Full run again

words.head: The lead ran the full run again

fullhealth.rerun.explain: The lead asked for the main line's full run once more.
fullhealth.rerun.instruction: None: the full run's verdict posts with `base.verified`, `base.flaky`, `base.broken` or `base.repaired`.

posture.changed.label: Posture changed

cases.focused: From then on, a piece needed only its own checks to land

head.otherwise: From then on, every landing needed the full run

posture.changed.explain: The checks the main line needs before a piece lands changed.
posture.changed.instruction: On the epic: the posture it left and the one it took, what set it, and why.

serving.held.label: Queue held
serving.held.explain: The queue stopped taking pieces until its setup is fixed.
serving.held.instruction: On the epic: the queue is held while its setup is fixed, and why.

deferral.breached.label: Note still open

words.head: A deferred note was still open

deferral.breached.explain: A review note put off for later was never answered by the time it was due.
deferral.breached.instruction: On the ticket: the deferred review note still open past its due point, with its follow-up.

blocker.recorded.label: Blocked
blocker.recorded.explain: Work cannot go on until someone answers or acts.
blocker.recorded.instruction: On the blocked ticket, or the epic when every ticket is blocked: the blocker, and whose answer or work unblocks it.

blocker.resolved.label: Unblocked
blocker.resolved.explain: What stood in the way was answered.
blocker.resolved.instruction: On the blocked ticket, or the epic: what unblocked it, and why.

decision.recorded.label: Decision
decision.recorded.explain: The lead or the operator made a call, and said why.
decision.recorded.instruction: On the ticket the decision concerns, or the epic: what, why, and who decided, the operator or the lead. A deferred finding links its follow-up item.

lease.granted.label: Lease taken
lease.granted.explain: Someone took a shared resource that only one may use at a time.
lease.granted.instruction: On the ticket whose work needs the lease: the lease, its holder and when it will be released.

lease.released.label: Lease let go
lease.released.explain: A shared resource is free again.
lease.released.instruction: On the same ticket: the lease is released.

story.held.label: Held
story.held.explain: The lead holds a planned story back for a reason of its own; the hold ends when the story is assigned, or when the lead clears it.
story.held.instruction: On the ticket: the lead's reason, in the lead's words.

story.unheld.label: Hold cleared

words.head: The lead cleared the hold on {subject}

story.unheld.explain: The lead no longer holds a planned story back.
story.unheld.instruction: On the ticket: the lead has cleared its reason, and the story is free to go on.

release.started.label: Release started
release.started.explain: The release of the delivered work began.
release.started.instruction: None: the release posts once it finishes.

release.finished.label: Released
release.finished.explain: The release ended, shipped or stopped at a target.
release.finished.instruction: On the epic: the release shipped, its commit and targets, and who approved it.

finish.met.label: Finish line met
finish.met.explain: One of the delivery's finish lines is now true.
finish.met.instruction: On the epic: the finish line and the evidence that met it.

hook.held.label: Stop held

cases.block: A hook kept the lead working

words.line: {hook}[, while {lanes:list:lane} worked][, with {pieces:list} still to land]

hook.held.explain: A hook stopped the lead from ending its turn while work was still open.
hook.held.instruction: None: a host hook held, or warned about, a lead's stop while no listener ran, and the entry shows in the record and the views.

peer.merged.label: Another delivery landed
peer.merged.explain: Another delivery on the same main line changed a file a piece here names.
peer.merged.instruction: None: the supervisor journals a merge by another delivery on the base that changed a file one of this delivery's open stories names, and the entry shows in the record and the views.

delivery.closed.label: Finished
delivery.closed.instruction: On the epic: the close-out summary; the epic moves to its final state.
